title: Easy to Hear
style: indie pop, 88 BPM, warm acoustic guitar, hummable melody, accessible heartfelt male vocal NZ/AU accent, no complexity, direct emotion, ear-friendly production, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Some songs try to be complicated
Some songs need a dictionary
This one only needs you listening
That's the only commentary

Easy to hear — easy to feel
Easy to know that the words are real
No production hiding what it means
Easy to hear — that's the thing

[CHORUS]
Easy to hear — no barrier
Easy to hear — no carrier
Just the voice and what it says
Easy to hear today

[VERSE 2]
Thirty languages could carry this
Ten cultures could hold the thread
The simplest melody survives
Long after the complex is dead

MOSOKO knows the principle
The lesson lands when it's simple
Easy to hear — easy to learn
Easy to feel — easy to earn

[BRIDGE]
You don't have to work hard to feel this.
That's the point.
That's always been the point.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Easy to hear — easy to hold
Easy to hear — warm not cold
Simple is the hardest to write
Easy to hear — done it right

[OUTRO]
Just listen.
That's all.
Easy.
